segments.text: Cryogenic liquids are a specific type of compressed gas with their own set of hazards and precautions.
segments.zh: 低温液体是一种特殊类型的压缩气体，有其自身的一系列危害和预防措施。

segments.text: A cryogenic liquid is an extremely cold liquid that at normal temperature would be a gas.
segments.zh: 低温液体是一种极冷的液体，在常温下它本应是气体。

segments.text: Due to their dependence on staying cold, cryogenic liquids may begin to boil violently
segments.zh: 由于低温液体依赖于保持低温，如果在室温下储存，

segments.text: if stored at room temperature.
segments.zh: 它们可能会开始剧烈沸腾。

segments.text: This puts cryogenic liquids in a category of their own when it comes to compressed
segments.zh: 这使得低温液体在压缩

segments.text: gases.
segments.zh: 气体中自成一类。

segments.text: With its special properties also come specific hazards.
segments.zh: 它的特殊性质也带来了特定的危害。

segments.text: First, direct contact with cryogenic liquids can cause cold burns on the skin and even
segments.zh: 首先，直接接触低温液体会造成皮肤冷灼伤，甚至

segments.text: frostbite.
segments.zh: 冻伤。

segments.text: Even touching the cylinders and piping containing these liquids can be dangerous as the coldness
segments.zh: 即使只是触摸装有这些液体的气瓶和管道也可能很危险，因为表面的低温

segments.text: of the surface may cause the skin to stick to it, similar to the childhood dare of putting
segments.zh: 可能会让皮肤粘在上面，就像小时候大家互相打赌

segments.text: your tongue on a cold metal pole.
segments.zh: 把舌头贴在冰冷金属杆上一样。

segments.text: When cryogenic liquids are transferred to a warmer container, they can boil and splash,
segments.zh: 把低温液体转移到较温暖的容器中时，它们可能会沸腾和飞溅，

segments.text: increasing the risk for skin exposure.
segments.zh: 增加皮肤暴露的风险。

segments.text: Since they are a liquid, cryogens can condense and then re-freeze inside openings in the
segments.zh: 由于它们是液体，低温液体可能会在气瓶开口内冷凝然后

segments.text: cylinder.
segments.zh: 再次冻结。

segments.text: When these openings are blocked, pressure can build up causing an explosion.
segments.zh: 当这些开口被堵住时，压力就会积聚，导致爆炸。

segments.text: Cryogenic oxygen is extremely dangerous and can cause combustible substances to ignite
segments.zh: 低温氧极其危险，会使可燃物质更容易点燃、

segments.text: and burn more easily or explode.
segments.zh: 燃烧甚至爆炸。

segments.text: As with other compressed gases, there are certain steps that can be taken to use cryogenic
segments.zh: 和其他压缩气体一样，可以采取一些措施来安全地使用低温

segments.text: liquids safely.
segments.zh: 液体。

segments.text: Since the ventilation of cryogenic liquids is important, using ventilation or oxygen
segments.zh: 由于低温液体的通风很重要，建议使用通风或氧气

segments.text: sensors and alarms is recommended.
segments.zh: 传感器及报警器。

segments.text: These monitors should be checked frequently before and during use.
segments.zh: 这些监测仪应在使用前和使用过程中经常检查。

segments.text: All equipment must be free of grease, oil, dirt, and other materials that are reactive
segments.zh: 所有设备都必须没有油脂、油、污垢以及其他与液氧等低温液体

segments.text: when they come in contact with cryogens like liquid oxygen.
segments.zh: 接触时会发生反应的物质。

segments.text: Remember that cryogenic liquids can alter the make-up of materials, making them brittle,
segments.zh: 要记住，低温液体会改变材料的结构，使其变脆，

segments.text: so you must choose the correct materials for the job.
segments.zh: 所以你必须为这项工作选择正确的材料。

segments.text: Cryogenic liquids should be stored in a special cylinder called a duer, which has a vacuum
segments.zh: 低温液体应储存在一种叫做杜瓦瓶的特殊容器中，它在液体和容器外壁之间

segments.text: space between the liquid and the outer walls of the container.
segments.zh: 有一层真空空间。

segments.text: All duers must have pressure relief valves and loose fitting lids to prevent pressure
segments.zh: 所有杜瓦瓶都必须配有泄压阀和松配合的盖子，以防止压力

segments.text: build up.
segments.zh: 积聚。

segments.text: When cryogenic liquids need to be moved, at least two people should transport the
segments.zh: 需要搬运低温液体时，应至少由两个人来搬运

segments.text: cylinder.
segments.zh: 容器。

segments.text: Don't allow moisture to get inside the container as it may freeze, causing ice
segments.zh: 不要让水分进入容器，因为水分可能会结冰，在泄压阀中

segments.text: blocks in the relief valves.
segments.zh: 形成冰堵。

segments.text: Finally, keep heat sources away from cryogenic liquids.
segments.zh: 最后，让热源远离低温液体。

segments.text: It's also important to protect yourself when handling cryogenic liquids.
segments.zh: 处理低温液体时，保护好自己也很重要。

segments.text: Appropriate personal protective equipment, or PPE, should be worn at all times.
segments.zh: 应始终穿戴合适的个人防护装备，也就是 PPE。

segments.text: This includes loose fitting gloves that can easily be thrown off as some liquid is spilled
segments.zh: 这包括宽松的手套，如果有液体洒进手套里，

segments.text: in them.
segments.zh: 可以很容易地甩掉。

segments.text: The gloves should be leather or specific to cryogenic work.
segments.zh: 手套应该是皮革的，或者是低温作业专用的。

segments.text: Rubber gloves must never be used, as rubber hardens when exposed to cryogenic liquids.
segments.zh: 绝不能使用橡胶手套，因为橡胶接触低温液体会变硬。

segments.text: Sea shields and goggles will protect your eyes and face from accidental splashes.
segments.zh: 面罩和护目镜可以保护你的眼睛和面部免受意外飞溅的伤害。

segments.text: They need to fit tightly against the skin to prevent liquid from leaking in should a
segments.zh: 它们需要紧贴皮肤，以防一旦发生飞溅时

segments.text: splash occur.
segments.zh: 液体渗入。

segments.text: Closed toed leather shoes are the best option when working with cryogenic liquids.
segments.zh: 使用低温液体时，包头皮鞋是最好的选择。

segments.text: Leather naturally repels any spilled liquid, while absorbent materials like sneakers will
segments.zh: 皮革天然能让洒落的液体流走，而运动鞋之类的吸水材料则会

segments.text: draw the liquid toward your skin.
segments.zh: 把液体引向你的皮肤。

segments.text: For this reason, a leather apron should also be worn over clothing.
segments.zh: 出于这个原因，还应该在衣服外面穿一件皮围裙。

segments.text: Metal jewelry like rings and watches shouldn't be worn when working with cryogenic liquid.
segments.zh: 使用低温液体时，不应佩戴戒指和手表之类的金属饰品。

segments.text: If the skin does come in contact with a cryogenic liquid, run the effect into area under room
segments.zh: 如果皮肤确实接触到了低温液体，要用室温的水冲洗受影响的部位

segments.text: temperature water for 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 15 分钟。

segments.text: Never use very hot or very cold water.
segments.zh: 切勿使用很热或很冷的水。

segments.text: The rewarming of the skin should be done gradually and can take up to 60 minutes.
segments.zh: 皮肤的复温应逐步进行，可能需要长达 60 分钟。

segments.text: If the area becomes frostbitten, seek medical attention immediately.
segments.zh: 如果该部位出现冻伤，应立即就医。

segments.text: The best way to prevent injury is to be familiar with using cryogenic liquids and to be careful.
segments.zh: 预防伤害的最好办法是熟悉低温液体的使用并保持小心。
